title: fea.domain
summary: Create a typed RunMat FEA physics domain.
description: `fea.domain(kind, Name, Value, ...)` creates thermo-mechanical, electro-thermal, electromagnetic, or CFD domain data for a RunMat FEA model.
behaviors: The domain kind selects the supported field set; unknown fields are rejected before object construction.

Finite real numeric physical fields accept all eight built-in integer classes. Exact integer values are retained until one host-only binary64 model-storage conversion, so sufficiently wide integers can round.
A nested thermo-field-source `revision` is a structural nonnegative integer and remains exact rather than crossing the physical-value binary64 boundary.
Resident numeric fields are rejected because domain construction does not perform provider execution.
integer_forms: Thermo-mechanical physical fields, including reference temperature, applied temperature delta, region temperature deltas, and time-profile coordinates/scales.
Electro-thermal physical fields, including reference temperature, applied voltage, conductivity scales, and time-profile coordinates/scales.
Electromagnetic reference frequency and applied current.
CFD density, viscosity, inlet velocity, turbulence intensity, and time-profile coordinates/scales.
Thermo field-source revision is structural and exact.

faqs.question: Does `revision` become binary64?
faqs.answer: No. Revision is structural model identity and is validated and stored as an exact nonnegative integer.
